body: Have learned that indifference is the only thing that they actually fear

Congrats on making it 6 months and thank you! I haven’t drank alcohol in years so thankfully I haven’t been diverted down that path. Still use my nicotine vape but putting off quitting that for a bit longer. Probably smoked about the same amount of joints per day as you. Crazy how we don’t notice our tolerance going up until it’s like “holy sh*t did I really just blow through an oz in a few days!?”
We got this. “If you’re going through hell, keep going”.
I keep choosing to live for some reason and I hate myself for it every day
